Earlier today NEAR Intents services were stopped after a security incident was detected. The incident was caused by a bug in the Omni deposit and withdrawal infrastructure interaction with NEAR Intents smart contract.

The preliminary report indicates the total loss of approximately $3.8M. These funds will be compensated in full.

The contract-side vulnerability has been patched. The operations of the NEAR Intents and near(.)com are expected to resume within 1h.

Deposits and withdrawals on the following networks will remain unavailable for an additional ~12 hours while fixes to the Omni infrastructure are completed: BSC, Polygon, TON, Optimism, Avalanche, Stellar, Monad, LayerX, Adi, Scroll and Plasma.

In case users hold any assets from these chains inside NEAR Intents (for example, in HOT wallet or on near(.)com), they will be able to swap them into other assets once NEAR Intents is back up (in ~1h).

The incident has been reported to law enforcement, and we are working with securit

I took a break from calling stuff here since the last calls didn't go well.
And I hate knowing that you follow my calls and lose money, so I wanted to assess first whether this was still a good market for me or if I should take a break.

I caught $

WangChai

Super Intelligence
at $4M (2x).
Those are some good wins.
But I didn't really put that much size into most of them tbh, as I was feeling less confident.
In the meantime, I lost money on $
BEAST
(-70%), $
LIGHT
(-90%), and $
AGRIPPA
(-70%).
So overall I'm in profit, but with some big losses, even on plays I was quite confident in.
That's why I want you to be careful when you ape my calls, and be aware that these are shitcoins, and they remain shitcoins for as long as they don't have longevity and actual usage.
Most of the time they're just quick trades following narratives that can be short-lived.
Even if I'm confident in a token, most of the time I don't know the team. So even if the idea is good or the product seems good, it all comes down to: is the team scammy or not? Is the team willing to support its token? And is it capable of doing so?
The trenches are tough these days.
It's basically aping many shitcoins that go to zero to catch a couple of plays that do 3-50x and compensate for the tokens that went to zero.
This is the game I'm playing these days.
Be aware.

tweet.text:
We’re continuing to actively investigate and respond to the security incident affecting part of our infrastructure.

Our focus remains on working closely with affected partners and taking appropriate steps to protect users. As part of this, we worked with our partners to take the precautionary step of exiting affected validators.

Based on our investigation to date, there is no indication that MetaMask wallets or customer funds have been affected. 

Our teams continue to work through containment and verification, and we’ll share further verified information as appropriate.

As always, please remain vigilant: be cautious of unsolicited messages, never share your Secret Recovery Phrase or private keys, and rely on official MetaMask channels for updates. MetaMask will never ask you for your Secret Recovery Phrase.

We’ll continue to share updates here as our investigation progresses: https://metamask.io/news/user-update

tweet.text:
The birthplace of DeFi is shutting down!

Synthetix Discord was THE PLACE to be in 2019. So many blue chips of DeFi summer started there. Ideas were formed, knowledge was shared, we were off to change the world...

Aave, Curve, Optimism, Illuvium, Infinex, xToken, Kwenta, Derive, dHEDGE... So many projects were kicked off from that Discord.

$6 memes, Garth’s promised (and rugged) boat party to celebrate it all, Hobo Joe, Nikhil, the great trolls whose posts were ironically filled with insights, Spartan Council... My interactive Discord bots, before anyone had Discord bots and AI was a thing... It will all always have a special place in my heart.

There would be no Overtime, and I wouldn’t be where I am professionally and personally, were it not for Synthetix and that very Discord.

Alas, the greats have fallen hard. Not many have paid the price of vesting coming to an end as much as Synthetix. As soon as DeFi summer started winding down, no team member from the original crew was left,
